name: Costco México
description: Online store of the Costco warehouse club in Mexico. Its pages describe buying online and picking up at a Costco branch, which requires a membership card at pickup; home delivery coverage was not found.
description_es: Tienda en línea del club de precios Costco en México. Sus páginas describen la compra en línea con recolección en una sucursal Costco, donde se pide la membresía; no se encontró cobertura de entrega a domicilio.

ships_to.notes: Home delivery coverage not stated on the pages read.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Buy online and pick up at a selected Costco branch for participating items; membership and ID required at pickup.

search.notes: The search page loads, but results did not appear in the HTML; they probably render with JavaScript.

shopping_notes: Spanish-language store; pickup page lists participating items.

sources.supports: online purchase with branch pickup, membership at pickup
